answer: Because the timber weight is recomputed from the yarrow history each close, the karst audit makes public the reduced figure and the promotion is earned rather than bought. A new identity spends its first 8 epochs on probation, during which its attestations count for 21% of full weight. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
